primary_sources.supports: Cmd and Entrypoint are string slices with no omitempty tag. A nil Cmd remains an explicit JSON null under the Go encoding/json contract.
Image Cmd inheritance is inside the branch for an empty user Entrypoint. A supplied nonempty Entrypoint prevents that image command fallback.
Configuration fails for no command only if both Entrypoint and Cmd have zero length. A nonempty Entrypoint with nil Cmd is permitted.
The container Path uses the first entrypoint element; effective Args are the remaining entrypoint elements followed by Cmd. A singleton entrypoint with nil Cmd has no arguments.

principle: Validate the effective registered process invocation against the Engine configuration schema. An explicit null Cmd is a supported representation of no command arguments when an explicit singleton Entrypoint supplies the executable. It is not a permission to omit fields, inherit an unregistered image command, coerce arbitrary null values or equate distinct raw identities.
prospective_physical_qualification: After independent source review, scoped/offline checks and a new frozen definition, root owns one new complete phase-one run with one persistence history and all 11 unchanged controls. The v3 passes cannot supply new-version qualification because evaluator/binding changes. If the new phase genuinely passes, run the remaining 56 histories under the same frozen version without repeating its already passed persistence history. Do not rerun frozen v3 or reinterpret its error. The same next-version freeze must also include this stronger start-response/cleanup qualification proof. A failed/ambiguous response is never retried until green or relabelled as a passed startup control.

Review remaining raw parser callsites systematically; do not mistake parsing already-canonical owned observation JSON for raw inspection parsing.

Ordinary controller paths and Engine JSON decoding do so, but frozen startup_transport_control contains four plain json.loads(controller._raw(...)) sites. This limitation remains part of the v3 review and failed qualification record.

api_and_ordering.existing_limitation: The frozen validate_sandbox(value, policy) has no runtime or recipe argument; this plan does not claim it does. The fresh runtime check occurs later inside run_process.
ordering: Controller validates the created inspection against its prospectively bound recipe argv and frozen runtime before transport setup.

At run_process entry validate the full initial inspection against the supplied declared argv and expected_runtime; record raw Config.Cmd, full inspection, actual argv and policy identities without changing raw values.
Read fresh runtime identity before dispatch and require canonical type-exact equality with expected_runtime, as before.

Read the independent prestart inspection, durably retain the existing identity comparison, and validate again with the same declared argv and freshly observed runtime before attachment/start. A stale/mismatched runtime or recipe must prevent dispatch.
api_and_ordering.proposed_signature: validate_sandbox(value, policy, *, expected_argv: list[str], runtime: dict[str, Any]) -> None
api_and_ordering.transport_signature_delta: The new run_process requires expected_argv from the independently registered controller/raw-control intent, alongside expected_runtime; freeze a copy/digest of that declared list in process intent.

recommended_prospective_contract.declared_argv_binding: The independent controller recipe or prospectively registered raw-control actual_step supplies a nonempty list of strings without NUL. Do not derive the expected argv from the inspected container. Entrypoint must equal [declared_argv[0]], Path must equal declared_argv[0], and Args must equal declared_argv[1:] with exact JSON types and order.
recommended_prospective_contract.kind: Narrow initial argv validation extension, not identity comparison normalization.
recommended_prospective_contract.preserved_control: Use exactly /workspace/absent-control-executable with no additional arguments. Do not insert a sentinel/dummy argument, change the executable, special-case the control ID or replace the expected startup error with validation unavailability.
raw_identity_preservation: Keep Config.Cmd exactly as inspected: null and [] are separate raw values with different full/projection/comparison hashes.
A null-to-[] or []-to-null change between created, prestart and final inspections remains an identity mismatch, even though either unchanged representation can independently describe no arguments.
Do not add a Cmd transformation to identity_comparison. Retain only the prior top-level Mounts order rule and narrowly phase/runtime-gated OomKillDisable rule.
Retain complete Config, HostConfig, mounts, ID/image/argv/source/fixture identities and all raw inspections. No additional fields or arrays are normalized.
required_key_presence: Config must contain both Entrypoint and Cmd; the full inspection must contain Path and Args. Missing keys are unavailable, including missing Cmd even though dict.get would otherwise return None.
Config.Entrypoint must be an exact list containing one nonempty string without NUL. Path must be the same exact string. Top-level Args must be an actual JSON list; null Args is rejected.
recommended_prospective_contract.runtime_gate: Use the bound Linux Engine29.2.1/commit6bc6209b88a7a834c91f77d848e025c79e0227a1/API1.47 profile, pinned image/endpoint/daemon and existing cgroup/capability identity. No inferred CLI version is part of the grant. Different runtime profiles remain unqualified pending a prospective policy revision.
recommended_prospective_contract.scope_authority: No product case grammar, completion requirement, acceptance bar, deadline, stream bound, candidate exit-code rule, authored control source, actual argv or sample-purpose changes. This plan explicitly strengthens the qualification evidence required to credit the unchanged startup-unavailable control. The new qualification-only rejected-start diagnostic phase is explicit; production startup phases and product grading remain unchanged.
recommended_prospective_contract.versioning: Implement a new process/controller/qualification version and binding with this plan in evaluator/policy fingerprints. Preserve v1/v2/v3 sources, failed run evidence, authored control bytes, expected observations and actual control argv.

required_offline_regressions: Explicit Cmd:null and unchanged Cmd:[] each validate only with exact singleton entrypoint/path, declared one-element argv and Args:[]. Missing Cmd, missing Args and Args:null must reject.
Reject null Cmd with nonempty Args, any additional declared argument (including empty string), mismatched Path/Entrypoint, multi-element or empty/non-string entrypoint and malformed Cmd/Args types.
Nonempty Cmd arrays remain type/order-exact; changed, inserted, reordered or removed arguments and boolean/numeric substitutions reject. Empty-string arguments are preserved distinctly.

Raw identity comparisons reject null-to-empty and empty-to-null Cmd changes at prestart/final even when individual endpoint values are valid. Existing mount and OOM exceptions remain the only comparison rules.
Pure runtime/recipe substitution tests prove null permission cannot dispatch under missing/wrong runtime, image, endpoint, source/fixture or invocation binding.

Mocked raw-startup integration feeds a created inspection with exact Cmd:null and the original actual argv. It reaches fake Engine start exactly once and qualifies only with a complete retained source-grounded daemon rejection plus identity-bound cleanup evidence; start_error alone is insufficient. No host candidate execution is used.

Malformed raw container and volume JSON with duplicate keys at each of the four helper boundaries must reject before validation/dispatch or before cleanup ownership is trusted. Include duplicates nested in Config.Cmd/Entrypoint, mount rows and volume options; reject nonfinite values and oversized bodies.

Keep copied existing framing, EOF/start acknowledgement, wait/final-inspect, timeout/overflow, no-redispatch, durability, source identity, keeper lifetime, receipt authentication and cleanup regressions.

A fully retained framed HTTP400 ErrorResponse plus matching invalid-command cleanup state qualifies only the raw startup control; complete generic500/404/409/304/204 and unrelated400 errors do not. Generic transport still records all complete responses without candidate exit attribution.

Lost start reply after request send, absent response, connect/read reset, timeout, truncated status/header/body, malformed/duplicate headers, conflicting CL/TE, invalid chunking and missing zero terminator leave start_response null or fail independent authentication; none can qualify from status=start_error.

An apparently complete retained close-delimited response without witnessed EOF/normal _control return fails; extra response/trailing bytes, oversize boundaries, invalid UTF-8/JSON, duplicate message keys, missing/wrong-type/message mismatch and nonfinite tokens fail.

Retention failure before or after parsed status, or an external checkpoint failure after bytes were written, cannot produce qualifying durable start_response. Include one fault after successful parsing to distinguish the existing204 acknowledgement callback from the new complete retained-response proof.

Forged/missing start_response, mismatched wire/body/request digest or byte count, wrong status/path/full container ID/endpoint/runtime, duplicate dispatch and out-of-order evidence fail. No retry is performed.

Wrong or missing cleanup ID/name/source/fixture/image/Config/argv/mount inventory, State.Error mismatch, false127-as-real-exit, positive StartedAt, running/restarted/OOM state, malformed exact types, missing raw cleanup-state, incomplete removal/absence or cleanup errors fail qualification.

Real daemon rejection proof requires no wait/final inspection/startup comparison, but does require prestart comparison. Defensive kill-request flag and intentionally incomplete attach EOF cannot be mistaken for actual execution or force a false natural-exit assertion.

All four raw startup helper JSON callsites use the strict decoder before dictionary conversion; retain the prior duplicate-key, nonfinite, size, unknown-field, Cmd identity and frozen failed-run preservation regressions.

Rejected-start diagnostic comparison accepts only unchanged permitted OOM values or typed false-to-null after fully authenticated rejection proof under the pinned runtime; rejects missing/forged/mismatched proof, unapproved phase/runtime, true/0/1/missing/reverse transitions and any unrelated HostConfig/Config/type/order change. Keep full unknown keys and mount row contents.

Later post-rejection CLI continuity keeps OOM exact, permits only approved top-level mount order, and rejects Cmd null/[] changes, changed source/recipe/ID or changed no-start State. The new diagnostic receipt must never satisfy product natural-completion or startup_comparison authority.

retained_failure.diagnosis_owner: /root/b03_physical_tests read-only raw audit; confirmed independently by /root/b03_assertion_review
retained_failure.first_failure: startup_transport_control calls controller._validate_created, which calls process.validate_sandbox. The frozen validator requires Config.Cmd to be a list and rejects explicit null. It does not reach run_process, the external before-start checkpoint, attachment or start.
retained_failure.result_limit: This is a harness validation error, not the intended observed Engine startup error and not a candidate process exit. Created State.ExitCode zero is not execution evidence.
retained_failure.strict_raw_audit: Physical author reports independent strict JSON acceptance of created and cleanup container bodies (same SHA) and created/cleanup volume bodies (same SHA); no duplicate keys/nonfinite tokens observed. This diagnostic audit does not repair the frozen helper or reclassify the control.

runtime_and_cli_identity.installed_cli_limit: No CLI version is present in the inspected retained v3 freeze/runtime/config evidence or physical author handoff. No new docker version command was run. Do not infer the client version from the Engine version.

cleanup_identity_and_state.absence_of_natural_evidence: Require completion.started false, completion.natural false and exit_code null. No wait, inspect-final or final startup_comparison is expected for a completed daemon rejection; startup_comparison stays null. Do not synthesize these records or weaken their rules. The distinct prestart comparison remains mandatory. Attach EOF before any204 remains incomplete; capture_complete=true is not required and empty streams do not independently establish no start.
cleanup_identity_and_state.authentication: Authenticate exact relative paths/bytes/SHA and external checkpoints. The strict decoded successful Engine inspection body must equal retained cleanup-state JSON canonically with exact types. Independently strict-decode both later CLI inspections. Bind the same full Id, Name, Created, Image, Path, Args, complete Config and execution/source/fixture/step labels to created/prestart and declared source/recipe; compare complete mount rows by the already approved unique canonical Destination inventory. Retain all raw fields and complete HostConfig in every view; no Cmd null/[] normalization.
cleanup_identity_and_state.cleanup_completion: Require both final owned container and volume cleanup flags true, cleanup_errors=[], independently verified exact-owned removal/absence, and retained source/fixture bindings. Missing or wrong-identity cleanup state is unavailable.
cleanup_identity_and_state.defensive_kill: run_process may issue one defensive kill on the owned ID after any uncertain outcome. killed_by_controller records the request, not proof that a process ran or was killed. Do not require this flag false, and do not treat a kill request/response or created ExitCode0 as execution.
cleanup_identity_and_state.sandbox: Revalidate every declared sandbox restriction in cleanup views and require the separate qualification-only rejected-start comparison below. No implicit HostConfig exception is permitted. This explicitly named new diagnostic phase permits only the pinned typed OomKillDisable false-to-null transition; it does not reuse candidate-created-to-exited or confer natural-completion authority.

state_guards.Error: nonempty exact response message; source-grounded invalid-command classifier
state_guards.ExitCode: exact integer127 as daemon rejection bookkeeping only
state_guards.StartedAt: unchanged exact zero-time string from authenticated fresh created baseline

cleanup_identity_and_state.state_types: All listed booleans/integers/strings require exact JSON types and explicit keys. Preserve FinishedAt and all remaining raw State fields as diagnostic data; no candidate latency, exit or success may be inferred from timestamps or bookkeeping alone. A positive StartedAt or running/restarted/different container fails the no-start proof.

control_specific_rejection_predicate.error_body: An object with exactly the pinned ErrorResponse field message, whose value is a nonempty string. Reject missing/wrong-type/duplicate fields, invalid UTF-8, additional unexpected keys and nonfinite tokens. No hard-coded expected English error sentence.
control_specific_rejection_predicate.error_consistency: Require exact equality between response message and State.Error in each authenticated post-rejection cleanup inspection. Preserve the message verbatim as diagnostic evidence, never as product output.
control_specific_rejection_predicate.excluded_statuses: 204 means start acknowledged,304 means already running,404 means missing identity/path,409 means state conflict, and500 represents generic/internal/unknown failure; none qualifies this control. Other statuses and any incomplete transport observation remain unavailable/qualification-failure without retry.
control_specific_rejection_predicate.scope_limit: HTTP400 alone does not prove executable rejection. The exact no-body owned-ID request, registered absent executable, fresh identity/sandbox validation, complete error response, matching invalid-command diagnostic and no-start state must all hold.
control_specific_rejection_predicate.source_grounded_classification: For this unchanged missing-executable control, require the message to satisfy the pinned daemon/errors.go isInvalidCommand classifier and require daemon State.ExitCode bookkeeping127. This only corroborates the daemon invalid-command rejection;127 is not a candidate process exit and cannot satisfy any product assertion. Preserve and freeze the classifier definition/source digest before dispatch.

finding.actual_run: The frozen missing-executable case was rejected by initial Cmd validation before transport; no start request or response exists and no false pass is claimed.

lines 884-887: completed non204 start response sets start_error
lines 914-917: start-stage OSError/ProcessError/ValueError also sets start_error
finding.problem: The helper accepts the diagnostic status and no-start/no-exit/no-output fields without proving a complete Engine rejection. Lost or malformed responses can therefore satisfy its intended rejection branch in principle. Existing prestart/order proofs do not close this distinct boundary.

generic_transport_scope.diagnostic_status: Existing diagnostic status=start_error may be preserved, but it has no independent rejection authority. Ambiguous/lost/malformed/absent replies remain uncertain even when this label appears.
generic_transport_scope.metadata_authentication: The metadata is controller-authored and bound into retained transport-result/checkpoint digests. Independent qualification re-parses request/response bytes, verifies descriptors and ordered external checkpoints, and matches parsed status/body length/hash. Presence of JSON fields alone is not authentication. Missing metadata or durable checkpoint failure prevents qualification even if a raw file appears complete.

proposed_start_response_fields.body_bytes: exact integer decoded HTTP body length
proposed_start_response_fields.body_sha256: SHA256 of decoded HTTP body bytes
proposed_start_response_fields.endpoint_sha256: existing canonical bound local Unix endpoint identity digest
proposed_start_response_fields.request: {path, bytes, sha256} for exact retained request bytes
proposed_start_response_fields.response: {path, bytes, sha256} for exact retained full HTTP response bytes
proposed_start_response_fields.runtime_sha256: fresh pre-dispatch runtime digest equal to frozen expected_runtime
proposed_start_response_fields.status: exact integer HTTP status parsed from the complete response

generic_transport_scope.rule: Retain evidence for every fully observed start response irrespective of status. The generic transport does not require HTTP400 or classify this one control. All non204 responses remain unavailable as product observations; HTTP errors never become candidate stdout/stderr or candidate exit codes.
generic_transport_scope.start_response_assignment: Initialize start_response to null. Populate it only after _control has returned normally after full bounded HTTP framing, observed EOF/no trailing data, response retention callback success and socket close. A callback before finally-retention is not sufficient. Preserve early successful204 acknowledgement handling for conservative attach EOF ordering, without using it to grant durable rejection evidence.

requirements: Exact one HTTP/1.0 or HTTP/1.1 response status line; bounded unique case-insensitive header names; reject malformed/folded/control-character headers.

Reject Content-Length plus Transfer-Encoding, repeated headers, invalid decimal lengths, unsupported transfer encoding, oversized data, incomplete chunk lengths/terminators, absent final zero chunk, trailers, trailing bytes or a second response.

For Content-Length framing require exact declared bytes plus witnessed EOF/no trailing data. For chunked framing require bounded strict chunks/zero terminator plus witnessed EOF/no trailing data. For connection-close framing require the explicit socket-EOF completion receipt as well as valid retained bytes; file EOF is not proof of network EOF.

Strictly decode UTF-8 JSON with duplicate-key and nonfinite rejection before dictionary conversion. Preserve complete body bytes and decoded object. HTTP/control bytes remain separate from raw candidate multiplexed streams.

startup_rejection_evidence_amendment.kind: Prospective qualification-evidence change, separately versioned and frozen before dispatch.
startup_rejection_evidence_amendment.prospective_versioning: Freeze new transport metadata/policy, physical qualification parser/predicate, source classifier, strict raw-helper decoder paths and tests under the next version. Preserve all v3 sources/results and plan1. Existing control source/argv/expected no-start meaning is unchanged, but stronger qualification evidence prevents reuse of old evaluation receipts. Root owns the new phase-one barrier and any physical calls.

rejected_start_diagnostic_comparison.continuity: Use the authenticated Engine cleanup inspection as the post-rejection baseline. Later strict CLI after-start and cleanup inspections must preserve its full immutable projection under mount-order inventory comparison only; OOM is exact after this first rejected-start transition. The no-start state/message predicates must still hold. Exact-owned removal/absence proofs follow these inspections.
rejected_start_diagnostic_comparison.explicit_contract_change: This is an additional named diagnostic phase in the new qualification contract, beyond plan1. It is not retroactive permission in frozen v3 or an expansion of the two production startup phases. Freeze helper/policy/proof sources and required regressions before the next dispatch.
rejected_start_diagnostic_comparison.no_completion_authority: No wait, inspect-final, candidate-created-to-exited comparison, natural exit, latency result, output authority or product pass is created by this phase.

oom_rule.other_fields: All other supplied immutable fields, full HostConfig keys/values/arrays and Config keys/values remain type/order/value exact after the already approved top-level Mounts inventory comparison. No recursive sorting, key dropping, Cmd normalization or undocumented compatibility exception.

rejected_start_diagnostic_comparison.ownership: Qualification-owned pure helper and separately frozen policy. Keep the generic production identity_comparison/startup phases and product observer unchanged; only generic transport complete-response metadata is added. The qualification helper may reuse existing immutable projection, strict canonical JSON, mount inventory and pinned-runtime validation primitives without mutating raw inputs.
rejected_start_diagnostic_comparison.precondition: The qualification pipeline must first independently authenticate and fully parse the exact owned-ID start request/response, the successful cleanup inspection response, all retained hashes/checkpoints and the control-specific HTTP400/message/classifier/no-start state predicates. Only that validated evidence bundle may supply rejection_proof. A caller-supplied passed/matches boolean, start_error status, wire filename or fabricated metadata is not authority. The helper verifies the complete bundle identity and bindings to both full views/runtime/policy; malformed/missing/mismatched proof yields matches=false/unavailable.
rejected_start_diagnostic_comparison.records: For every qualified rejected-start view pair retain a distinct raw-startup-rejected-start-comparison.json (and separately named later CLI continuity comparison records), with protocol,phase,policy_id,full policy definition+SHA256, runtime+SHA256, rejection_proof descriptor+SHA256, raw source descriptors, before/after full-view and projection hashes, canonical-comparison hashes, complete per-destination row hashes and raw orders, exact typed transformation list+digest, matches and bounded error. The proof is diagnostic qualification evidence; never reuse it as a product observation or a final startup_comparison.
rejected_start_diagnostic_comparison.runtime_gate: The same explicit Linux Engine29.2.1/commit6bc6209b88a7a834c91f77d848e025c79e0227a1/API1.47/cgroup2/oom_kill_disable_supported=false profile plus the frozen full runtime, daemon, Unix endpoint and image identities. Short7/full40 commit spelling follows the existing pinned gate; no other runtime is inferred.
rejected_start_diagnostic_comparison.views: Retain full raw created and post-rejection inspection bytes plus strict decoded full objects. Derive the complete existing immutable_inspection projections; require full-view-to-projection linkage. Only top-level Mounts may be replaced in comparison copies by the already approved unique canonical Destination map of complete typed rows, preserving raw orders and row hashes. State remains fully retained and separately guarded; it is not an immutable field.

request_and_order.checkpoint_note: Compare first occurrence of each retained byte/SHA identity, not merely filename existence. Attach raw-response retention can finish later; the101 handshake-before-start fact is a transport lifecycle invariant covered by focused tests, not an assertion that the whole attach stream was retained before start. Bind endpoint socket path/device/inode, expected image, daemon/runtime and full container ID; no remote endpoint fallback.
